raw.description:
intro

Außendienst in PLZ 80-86 | Deutsch C1-C2 | Führerschein + Dienstwagen | 30 Tage Urlaub

Rückenprobleme sind der häufigste Grund für Arbeitsunfähigkeit in Deutschland.

ViVira hat die Lösung: Wir machen digitale Bewegungstherapie per App. Immer verfügbar, einfach, wirksam und von der Krankenkasse erstattet. Vivira wurde aus dem Bedürfnis geboren, Muskel-Skelett-Erkrankungen so unkompliziert und effektiv wie möglich zu therapieren.

Deine Chance: In dieser Rolle bist Du das Gesicht zu unseren Kunden in Deiner Region. Du betreust vor allem niedergelassene Allgemeinmediziner und Orthopäden persönlich vor Ort, baust Beziehungen aus und sorgst dafür, dass Vivira optimal in den Praxisalltag integriert wird. Du bist die persönliche Verstärkung für Dein Team, das weitgehend remote arbeitet – immer dort unterwegs, wo direkter Kontakt den Unterschied macht.
Sorge mit uns dafür, dass Rückenschmerzen nicht länger den Alltag bestimmen – sondern digitale Lösungen den Unterschied machen.

deine aufgaben umfassen

  • Betreuung, Ausbau und Entwicklung Deiner Vertriebsregion – mit Schwerpunkt auf persönlichen Praxisbesuchen (mind. 3 Tage/Woche im Außendienst)
  • Aufbau und Pflege vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu Ärzten und Praxisteams
  • Beratung, Schulung und Support rund um Vivira und digitale Verschreibung
  • Quartalsanalysen sowie strukturierte Rückmeldungen aus dem Praxisalltag an Produkt- und CRM-Team
  • Sorgfältige Dokumentation Deiner Aktivitäten im CRM (HubSpot)
  • Zusammenarbeit und Unterstützung des hybriden Teams bei der Aktivierung und Betreuung von Praxen
  • Mitgestaltung von Projekten und Vertriebsinitiativen im Team
  • Deine wichtigste Kennzahl: Die Anzahl der Vivira-Verordnungen in Deiner Region

das solltest du mitbringen

  • Du hast bereits einige Jahre Erfahrung im Außendienst, Vertrieb oder Account Management gesammelt und willst wirklich etwas bewegen.
  • Du bist persönlich vor Ort in Deinem Element und verstehst, wie der medizinische Praxisalltag tickt.
  • Du gehst auf Menschen zu, baust mit Empathie und Engagement echte Beziehungen auf und begeisterst Ärzte für neue Lösungen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und bringst Offenheit, Freude sowie Verbindlichkeit in Dein Team.
  • Du sprichst sehr gutes Deutsch (C1-C2) und gutes Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache).
  • Du hast einen Führerschein, damit Du flexibel Praxen besuchen kannst – ein Dienstwagen steht Dir zur Verfügung.

das erwartet dich bei vivira

  • Arbeitsplatz: Arbeite von Zuhause, vor Ort mit Deinen Teams oder aus dem Berliner HQ, in zentraler Lage.

  • Working Abroad: Die Möglichkeit, bis zu einem Monat pro Jahr remote aus dem EU-Ausland, dem EWR oder der Schweiz, Israel & UK zu arbeiten.

  • Recharge: 30 Urlaubstage – für echte Pausen und neue Energie.

  • Gesundheit: Beweglichkeit und Rückenpower direkt von uns für Dich – digitale Unterstützung, die Du selbst nutzen kannst.

  • Zukunft sichern: Mit erhöhtem Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur Altersvorsorge baust Du heute an morgen.

  • Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von exklusiven Vorteilen für Shopping, Technik & mehr.

  • Empfehlungsprämie: Netzwerk teilen lohnt sich – jede erfolgreiche Empfehlung wird belohnt.

  • Highlights: Mehrere Company- und Team-Events pro Jahr sorgen für Austausch, Spaß und ein echtes Wir-Gefühl.

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.
A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.
Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

We are looking for detail-oriented Data Annotators to join our team. In this role, you will help support Torc’s data annotation and quality assurance pipeline by labeling information from different sensors, including images and LiDAR, to help train AI systems used in autonomous trucks.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Annotator, you’ll work with both 2D images and 3D sensor data to help AI systems recognize and understand their surroundings. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Labeling objects using specialized tools to create:
    • 2D bounding boxes
    • 3D cuboids
    • Other shape types to represent vehicles, road features, obstacles, and more
  • Reviewing pre-labeled data to ensure it follows detailed guidelines
  • Accepting, rejecting, or correcting annotations using our software
  • Providing clear notes when corrections are needed
  • Learning and mastering our internal tools over time

Your work directly supports the development of safer autonomous vehicle technology by ensuring the AI models used on those vehicles are trained with high-quality, accurate data.

Who You’ll Work With

We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst to join our dynamic, remote cybersecurity team. The ideal candidate is a critical thinker, self-starter, and driven professional with hands-on experience using Crowdstrike or other EDRs. You will play a critical role in monitoring, triaging, and responding to cyber threats across our primarily Mac and Linux environments, with some Windows systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of fellow SOC analysts, incident responders, threat hunters, and cross-functional partners across IT, engineering, and DevOps to ensure our security posture remains strong. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, excels in high-pressure settings, and is skilled in writing CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL) (or similar) to create effective detections that protect our organization’s assets.

What You’ll Do

  • Monitor and triage security alerts.
  • Build, test, and refine detections to enhance threat identification across Mac, Linux, and Windows systems.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of security incidents, including malware, phishing, and advanced persistent threats, leveraging SIEM and EDR capabilities.
  • Perform proactive threat hunting using the SIEM and EDR features.
  • Investigate and respond to incidents swiftly, following established incident response protocols.
  • Document findings clearly and provide actionable remediation recommendations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen security controls and mitigate vulnerabilities.
  • Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends through self-directed learning.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for 24x7x365 SOC coverage, demonstrating reliability and accountability.
  • Escalate confirmed or suspicious incidents and cases to the Incident Response team.
  • 4-5+ years in a SOC and or active participant on incident response teams.
  • Hands-on experience with CrowdStrike (or other EDR), triaging security incidents.
  • Proven ability to write CQL (or similar) queries and build detections for threat monitoring.
  • Experience triaging alerts in a high-volume environment.
  • Experience with threat intelligence feeds, platform and OSINT tools (VirusTotal, etc.)
  • Familiarity with forensic analysis and evidence handling.

Skills and Attributes:

  • Exceptional critical thinking and analytical skills to address complex security challenges.
  • Self-starter with a proven ability to take initiative and deliver results independently.
  • Driven mindset, thriving in fast-paced, high-pressure remote work environments.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat landscapes, and attack vectors.
  • Proficiency in analyzing logs, network traffic, and endpoint data using CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM, particularly for Mac and Linux systems (Windows experience a plus).
  • Solid knowledge of incident response processes and methodologies.
  • Familiarity with operating systems, with primary expertise in Mac and Linux, and secondary knowledge of Windows.
  • High attention to detail and ability to make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development in cybersecurity.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Write and optimize detections to detect and investigate security events.
  • Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python) for automating SOC workflows.
  • Experience creating playbooks in Crowdstrike Fusion SOAR (or similar SOAR)
  • Knowledge of cloud security (GCP, AWS, and or Azure).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Who are we?

IOG, is a technology company focused on blockchain research and development. We are renowned for our scientific approach to blockchain development, emphasizing peer-reviewed research and formal methods to ensure security, scalability, and sustainability.

Our projects include the Cardano blockchain, as well as other products in the areas of decentralized finance (DeFi), governance, and identity management, aiming to advance the capabilities and adoption of blockchain and Web3 technology globally.

What the role involves:

The role of Research & Innovation Grants Specialist is to lead the end-to-end grants lifecycle for both foundational blockchain R&D (in areas such as formal methods, security/scalability, DeFi, governance, and digital identity) and its application in innovation projects across related industry verticals.. This includes scouting and qualifying opportunities, building a 12–24-month funding pipeline, shaping bid strategy, crafting high-quality applications aligned to funder priorities, and managing post-award budgets, deliverables, reporting, and compliance. The role coordinates inputs from research, finance, legal, and partnerships, and works closely with academic and industry collaborators to secure sustained investment that keeps research teams at the forefront of innovation. Success in the role looks like increased grant wins and total award value with a diversified funder mix; higher proposal win rates and faster submission cycles; on-time, audit-clean reporting with full contractual delivery; reusable bid assets/templates that raise quality and consistency; and repeat invitations from priority funders reflecting strong, trust-based relationships.

Grant Scanning & Pipeline Development

    • Monitor and assess funding opportunities from sources such as Horizon Europe, Innovate UK (IUK), National Science Foundation (NSF), and other international programs.
    • Build and maintain a forward-looking pipeline of relevant calls aligned to IOG’s research, innovation and venture priorities in blockchain and beyond.

Grant Application Development

    • Lead the preparation of high-quality grant proposals, including drafting technical sections, project plans, budgets, and impact narratives.
    • Coordinate inputs from researchers, engineers, and external partners to ensure applications are complete, accurate, and compelling.
    • Manage timelines and submission processes across multiple applications.

Project & Partnership Support

    • Collaborate with academic institutions, research consortia, and industry partners to co-develop joint applications.
    • Support the establishment of new partnerships that strengthen the competitiveness of bids.
    • Ensure clear communication and alignment between IOG’s research strategy and partner expectations.

Grant Compliance & Reporting

    • Oversee post-award grant management, including monitoring deliverables, budgets, and reporting obligations.
    • Maintain records of active grants, deadlines, and funding outcomes.
    • Ensure compliance with the requirements of different funding bodies.

Strategic Contribution

    • Provide insights on global funding trends in blockchain, Web3, and adjacent deep-tech research fields.
    • Advise leadership on strategic grant opportunities to diversify and sustain IOG’s research funding base.
    • Support internal communications by summarizing grant progress and outcomes for leadership and external reporting.

Requirements

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a STEM field, research management, or related area. PhD preferred or equivalent experience in research and innovation environments.
  • Demonstrable experience developing and managing successful grant applications in a research-driven or technology-driven organization.
  • Familiarity with major research and innovation funding programs (Horizon Europe, Innovate UK, NSF, etc.).
  • Experience working with international research consortia and multi-stakeholder collaborations.
  • Knowledge of blockchain, decentralized systems, or applied cryptography is advantageous.
  • Experience in project management, budgeting, and compliance monitoring.
  • Excellent grant writing, editing, and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong ability to translate complex blockchain, AI and computer science research into persuasive funding narratives.
  • Proven track record of securing research or innovation funding (EU, UKRI, NSF, or comparable).
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to identify and pursue high-value funding opportunities.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to build strong partnerships with academia, funders, and industry stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of blockchain, Web3, cryptography, or adjacent emerging technologies is highly desirable.

Benefits

  • Remote work
  • Laptop reimbursement
  • New starter package to buy hardware essentials (headphones, monitor, etc)
  • Learning & Development opportunities

En lien avec les activités métiers, vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

  • Gouvernance de la Donnée : Contribuer activement à la définition, à l'évolution et à la mise en œuvre de la gouvernance de la donnée, en garantissant la conformité aux règles de l'entreprise et aux réglementations en matière de protection des données.

  • Création et Maintenance des Catalogues de Données : Collaborer avec l'équipe métier pour créer et maintenir des catalogues de données, répertoriant les sources de données, leur origine, leur utilisation et leurs métadonnées.

  • Conduite du Changement : Participer à la mise en place de parcours de formation et de carrière évolutifs liés aux nouveaux rôles DATA, tout en répondants aux attentes data du parc.

Pourquoi rejoindre la communauté des Switchers ?

Rejoignez la communauté des Switchers et faites partie d'une aventure digitale passionnante au cœur de l'industrie nucléaire !

  • 💪 Plus de 55 ans d’expérience dans le nucléaire et positionné dans le top 3 des plus grandes entreprises d’ingénierie nucléaire.

  • 🚀 Participer à des projets stimulants avec un véritable impact sociétal.

  • 📈 De nombreuses opportunités de carrière, avec 70% de nos managers issus de la promotion interne.

  • Une expérience préalable dans l'un des secteurs suivants : Ingénierie, Maintenance, Exploitation, Projets, Chimie, PDR et Logistique, Sureté, Sécurité et Radioprotection, serait un atout.

Nous nous engageons au respect de l’égalité de traitement entre les candidats, et célébrons toutes les formes de diversité. Chez Assystem, seules les compétences comptent ! Si vous souhaitez porter à la connaissance d’Assystem une quelconque situation ou des besoins spécifiques, n’hésitez pas vous serez accompagné(e) !

Trouver des solutions au dérèglement climatique est la priorité du 21ème siècle, et implique de switcher à l’énergie bas-carbone. Chez Assystem, on s’est donc donné pour mission d’accélérer la transition énergétique partout dans le monde. Et pour y parvenir, nos 8 000 Switchers couplent leur expertise historique en ingénierie et en management de projet aux technologies digitales.

Présent dans 13 pays (Europe, Moyen-Orient, Asie), nous travaillons sur la production et la distribution d’électricité bas-carbone, à travers le développement des énergies nucléaires et renouvelables. Nous participons également à modernisation des réseaux électriques et l’électrification des usages, à travers l’hydrogène pour décarboner les secteurs des transports et de l’industrie.

Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.
Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

Role

The Senior Commissioning Engineer will own and implement the Serverfarm commissioning strategy in the execution of L4-L5 commissioning activities they are leading. They will drive quality by recommending and enforcing standards for testing the functional performance critical infrastructure systems, helping DEV teams to validate new equipment and suppliers, ensuring QA and QC of documentation, and identifying training requirements for new equipment and updated sequence of operations (SOO) for operations. This role is pivotal in enhancing ServerFarm’s competitive edge through delivery of cutting-edge technology solutions that are aligned for Operations and business requirements and future growth.
The ideal candidate will be comfortable traveling 50% of the time to our data center locations in the Houston, Texas and Atlanta, Georgia regions.

Key Accountabilities

  • Leads projects within the commissioning program to ensure evidence of performance and compliance as required by internal processes and customer requirements. Ensures quality of systems performance and workmanship by collaborating on and enforcing internal and external stakeholders’ and vendors’ adherence to rigorous, yet efficient testing standards, and ensures timely entry of complete and accurate documentation in the commissioning tool.
  • Ability to translate customer and operational requirements into technical details that support business realities around cost, quality, timing, scalability and sustainability for Serverfarm’s data center portfolio.
  • Ability to maintain ownership and focus in a fast-paced work environment while effectively prioritizing work.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to accuracy and delivering high-quality and timely business outcomes.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, managing multiple tasks with competing deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and internal and external stakeholders, vendors and customers.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical or closely aligned engineering discipline, or commensurate industry experience or military experience in lieu of degree may be acceptable.
  • 7+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems.

Preferred Skills

  • Chartered or Professional Engineer (PE).
  • Experience of working with large global data center providers in multiple regions globally.
  • Knowledge of local building codes and safety regulations in multiple jurisdictions.
  • Knowledge of critical data center equipment (Generators, Uninterruptible Power Supplies, Switchgear,Transformers, Power Feeders, Chillers, Plumbing, Fire Detection/Suppression, Air Handling Units, Computer Room Air Handling/Conditioning Units, Chillers, UPS, CRAH, CRAC…).
  • Strong record of mentoring and growing teams.
  • Excellent verbal and writing communication skills.

Travel Requirements

  • Regular travel (50% - 45% domestic/5% international) to data center locations to support Commissioning activities (L3-L5).
  • Vendor Factory visits and qualification (10%).
  • Occasional travel (5%) to industry conferences to maintain key partner and customer relationships.

Gouweloos Techniek biedt uitdagende projecten bij aansprekende opdrachtgevers

Wil jij als Elektromonteur werken aan uitdagende (renovatie)projecten in de utiliteit? Wij voeren projecten uit voor de overheid in beveiligde omgevingen, binnen het onderwijs en voor grote bedrijven zoals Amazon, Microsoft en Unilever.

Heb je affiniteit met high-end elektrotechniek zoals data- en beveiligingssystemen? En wil je aan de slag binnen een hecht team bij een echt Rotterdams bedrijf? Bij Gouweloos Techniek zit je goed. Dan ben jij de Elektromonteur die bij ons op zijn plek zit!

Wat we je bieden:

  • Uitdagende, vaak grote projecten, voornamelijk in de Randstad;

  • Een goed salaris + vergoeding voor storingsdiensten en overuren;

  • Een personenauto van de zaak naar eigen keuze;

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling;

  • 25 vakantiedagen + 13 adv-dagen;

  • Een familiaire en flexibele werkomgeving met korte lijnen in een hecht team collega’s die graag van elkaar leren;

  • Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid: wij zijn vaak hoofdaannemer;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Zowel binnen Gouweloos Techniek, maar ook breder binnen (de bedrijven van) de VDK Groep;

  • Een gezellige en informele werksfeer met regelmatig leuke uitjes, waaronder de F1 van Zandvoort, de Haring Party en vrijdag middag borrels in onze eigen bar.

Wat je gaat doen:

’s Ochtends vertrek je vanuit huis naar de locatie van jouw klus. Ons werkgebied omvat voornamelijk de Randstad. Dit doe je met je personenauto van de zaak.

Als Elektromonteur voer jij zelfstandig of in teamverband werkzaamheden uit aan elektrotechnische installaties. Samen met je collega’s ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van een project, van technische voorbereiding tot de oplevering aan de opdrachtgever. Hoge kwaliteit en een tevreden klant: daar ga jij voor.

Wat neem je mee?

  • 5-8 jaar werkervaring als elektromonteur;

  • Minimaal een mbo-3 diploma richting elektrotechniek;

  • VCA-Basis (VCA-Vol is een pré);

  • Rijbewijs B;

  • Een VOG is voor jou geen probleem;

  • De Rotterdamse ‘Niet lullen, maar poetsen’ mentaliteit.

Waar je het gaat doen:

Gouweloos Techniek houdt zich al sinds 1920 bezig met het oplossen van (elektro)technische vraagstukken voor de utiliteit: de overheid, het bedrijfsleven en onderwijsinstellingen. Dit doen we met een Rotterdamse mentaliteit en aanpak – niet lullen maar poetsen – maar ook met oog voor onze mensen. Naast het uitvoeren van elektrotechnische werkzaamheden, zijn we ook regelmatig als hoofdaannemer verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van complete technische projecten.

Requirements

VDK Installatiegroep, de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland!

Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snel groeiende VDK Groep (100 bedrijven, 5000 medewerkers), maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. Dit betekent dat je bij ons de voordelen van een grote organisatie ervaart – denk aan uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden, een stabiele basis en aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden – terwijl je tegelijkertijd de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt om je eigen stempel te drukken. Zo combineren we de kracht van de VDK Groep met de flexibiliteit en dynamiek van een zelfstandig bedrijf.

Heb je interesse?

Aarzel niet en neem direct contact op met Tim de Leeuw, Recruitment Business Partner van de VDK Groep. Dit kan door te bellen of te appen naar 06-83275613 of te mailen naar t.deleeuw@vdkinstallatiegroep.nl.

Our work involves building foundational platforms and ML-driven recommendation engines, developing systems to support evolving content types like live events, podcasts, and advertising, and providing essential toolings for studio partners to promote content, alongside comprehensive debugging and health tools to accelerate engineering velocity.

The nature of this role is a challenging blend of operating high-scale distributed systems, implementing advanced ML-driven personalization, and collaborating closely with our Product and UI teams. We are looking for a highly capable full-stack engineer to develop tools that improve the developer experience and empower our studio partners to innovate broadly and efficiently.

Snapshot of projects you may work on:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement debugging tools for their services.
  • Enhance our user interfaces to provide intuitive and seamless experiences for engineers, incorporating feedback and best practices to improve usability and adoption.
  • Incorporate GenAI tools to enhance developer productivity by automating repetitive tasks.

We would love to work with you if:

  • You have strong expertise with modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React/Typescript).
  • You have experience with at least one backend language/framework (e.g. Java/Python/Go).
  • You have experience building and consuming RESTful APIs (GraphQL is a plus).
  • You proactively communicate with cross-functional (such as product and UX) teams to drive projects.
  • You have a BS/MS in Computer Science, Applied Math, Engineering, or a related field.
  • You have experience working with teams distributed across multiple time zones.

It would be nice if:

  • You have experience with the latest GenAI stack (LLMs, RAG, Agents/Tools)
  • You have experience building distributed backend systems.
  • You have experience building enterprise level tools.
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $388,000.00 - $558,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusionis a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

We are seeking a strategic and detail-oriented Partner Field Performance Manager to design and deliver high-impact enablement programs that accelerate partner readiness, drive technical and commercial alignment, to fuel Seeq and partner-led revenue. This role focuses on helping our partners get up to speed quickly, understand our products, and succeed in selling and supporting our solutions while ensuring our Field team understand the same for the partners—ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced SaaS environments and knows how to turn enablement into a growth lever to drive Field Performance.

You'll report to the Senior Director of Field Performance and Learning and align closely with Seeq Partner KPIs to deliver a measurable impact on partner sales growth.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Design and deliver structured onboarding programs for partner sales and field teams.
  • Collaborate with Partner, Sales, Marketing and Field teams to align enablement content with GTM priorities and product updates.
  • Develop partner sales plays, rules of engagement, and toolkits to enable seamless collaboration between Seeq's sales team and partners' sales teams.
  • Maintain and evolve certification pathways, learning journeys, and partner-facing toolkits.
  • Develop Partner involvement in Seeq Prospecting Days
  • Act as the enablement point of contact for partner managers, channel leads, and alliances.
  • Facilitate partner deal clinics, feedback loops, and performance reviews.
  • Lead partner sales enablement at Seeq events, including workshops, demos, and joint sessions to foster stronger working relationships.
  • Design and manage enablement programs, monitor program effectiveness, and continuously improve based on partner feedback and performance data.
  • Track certification completion and enablement of content consumption across partner segments.
  • Correlate engagement with partner performance metrics to demonstrate a measurable impact on partner sales growth.
  • Ensure alignment with Seeq Partner KPIs, including revenue targets, deal velocity, and partner satisfaction.
  • Work with Seeq's internal teams to ensure alignment on partner strategies and field execution.
  • Partner with the Channel teams to ensure seamless enablement of program delivery.

Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • 2-5 years of experience in partner sales, partner enablement or channel programs.
  • Experience in designing and delivering enablement programs across global partner ecosystems.
  • Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong understanding of co-sell motions within SaaS or industrial technology ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with industrial sectors such as oil & gas, chemicals, pharma, or utilities.
  • Excellent relationship building, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • A self-starter mindset—comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth, entrepreneurial environment with a constant positive attitude.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, data protection industries, or platform communities.
  • Exposure to partner strategies or platform engagement.
  • Strengths-based coaching mindset or enablement certification.
  • Experience Building in Highspot

Benefits

Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments.

We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability.

We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

The Perks of Working at Seeq

  • Competitive salary plus commission incentives
    • $155,000-165,000 USD base salary
  • Benefits:
    • 12-week paid Seeq family leave
    • Unlimited PTO
    • Internet and mobile phone reimbursements
    • Medical benefits
    • Group term life insurance
    • Short-term and long-term disability insurance pre-tax benefits
    • Voluntary vision and dental (ortho)
    • Vacation bonus program
    • Employee Assistance Program
    • Generous home office allowance
    • The best co-workers (we've analyzed the data, so we know it's true.)
    • Pet-friendly workspace (your dog will be so happy to have you home)
    • You love your job!

Seeq provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.

Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.

Basic Requirements

  • Being a resident in Singapore for the last Year consecutively and having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Singapore

  • Having an email address associated with an Apple ID and experience and know-how of Apple products

  • Up-to-date familiarity with prevailing trends in applications, music & video with a keen interest in internet research

  • Flexibility to work across a diverse set of task types, including news, audio tasks, and relevance

  • Daily access to a secure broadband internet connection, computer, and relevant software
